SUBJECT:        SUMMARY OF SEPTEMBER 15, 2026, PUBLIC MEETING REGARDING
                PROPOSED LICENSE REQUEST TO MODIFY QUALITY ASSUANCE
                TOPICAL REPORT REGARDING ELIGIBILITY PATHWAYS FOR REACTOR
                OPERATORS (EPID L-2026-LRM-0111)


On September 15, 2026, the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) staff held an
Observation pre-submittal public meeting1 with representatives from NextEra Energy (NextEra).
The purpose of the meeting was for NextEra to discuss its plans to submit a change to the
Quality Assurance Topical Report (QATR), and to receive NRC staff feedback on what
information would be needed to support the NRC staff review of the submittal. The NextEra
request would allow supplemental eligibility pathways for use alongside existing pathways for
Reactor Operator and Senior Reactor Operator candidates.

During the meeting, NextEra staff presented slides2 that described the proposed change.

The NRC staff provided the following comments on information and considerations that would
support its review of the proposed change:

    •   NRC staff stated that the submittal should articulate clearly whether the proposed
        change will remain Institute of Nuclear Power Operations (INPO) accredited;
    •   NRC staff stated that the submittal should clarify what is meant by Systems Approach to
        Training (SAT)-based rigor and how it supports acceptability of the program; and
    •   NRC staff asked if there was a common QATR document for all sites. Next Era indicated
        that a common fleet, QATR was used for the operating plants. Further, NextEra clarified
        that plants undergoing restart would transition to the same QATR as part of the restart
        process.

Then, the meeting transitioned to the closed session. During the closed portion of the meeting
additional details were discussed regarding the INPO accreditation aspect of the approach.


1 The meeting notice is available under Agencywide Documents Access and Management System (ADAMS)

Accession No. ML26247A002.
2 The slides are available under ML26257A311.
                                               -2-


The NRC staff did not make any regulatory decisions at the meeting. Following the open
discussion and prior to the closed session an opportunity was afforded to any other participants
who wished to ask questions or make comments. No questions or comments were received
from the public.

Please direct any inquiries regarding this meeting to me at 301-415-2481 or Ed.Miller@nrc.gov.
